title: 彭博：无票球迷才是国际足联世界杯经济主角
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: At the World Cup, players get all the glory.
segments.zh: 世界杯上，球员们赢得了所有荣耀。

segments.en: FIFA gets all the money, but the fans, the fans get memories that last a lifetime.
segments.zh: 国际足联赚得盆满钵满，而球迷们收获的是终生难忘的回忆。

segments.en: I'm Randall Williams, a sports business reporter at Bloomberg News and I'm taking you inside the world's biggest sporting events.
segments.zh: 我是兰德尔·威廉姆斯，彭博新闻社的体育商业记者，今天带您走进全球最大的体育赛事。

segments.en: Today we are headed to the most watch showdown on Earth, the FIFA World Cup.
segments.zh: 今天我们要前往地球上最受瞩目的对决——国际足联世界杯。

segments.en: Let's talk about the folks who really matter in the FIFA World Cup.
segments.zh: 我们来聊聊世界杯上真正重要的人。

segments.en: The fans. Tens of thousands of fans from across the globe are expected to visit the US, Mexico, and Canada for this extravagant experience.
segments.zh: 球迷们。预计将有来自全球的数万名球迷前往美国、墨西哥和加拿大，体验这场盛事。

segments.en: And when they arrive, they won't just bring jerseys and flags.
segments.zh: 他们抵达时，带来的不仅是球衣和旗帜。

segments.en: They'll bring culture, energy, and of course, money.
segments.zh: 还有文化、活力，当然，还有金钱。

segments.en: For the first time since 1994, North America will be the center of the football soccer universe.
segments.zh: 自1994年以来，北美将首次成为足球世界的中心。

segments.en: Ghana, Argentina, France, Brazil, Spain, Germany, Morocco, and 41 more nations all in one place.
segments.zh: 加纳、阿根廷、法国、巴西、西班牙、德国、摩洛哥，以及其他41个国家齐聚一堂。

segments.en: And if you've never experienced global soccer culture, this is different.
segments.zh: 如果你从未体验过全球足球文化，那这次绝对不同。

segments.en: This is March Madness and College Football Pandemonium combined.
segments.zh: 这就像疯狂三月和大学橄榄球的狂热合体。

segments.en: This isn't just tailgating, it's chance in the streets, drums, flags, and colors taking over entire city blocks.
segments.zh: 这不仅是车尾派对，更是街头狂欢，鼓声、旗帜、色彩占领整个街区。

segments.en: With European football versus other sports in America, it's fascinating because of how kind of like tribal and park design it can be, that it creates a completely different kind of atmosphere,
segments.zh: 欧洲足球与美国其他体育的对比很有趣，因为它充满部落感和公园设计，营造出完全不同的氛围。

segments.en: both at the domestic level and also the international level.
segments.zh: 无论是在国内还是国际层面。
